turns.text: Hi, I am Leander Hutupan. Where is my print and what is the tracking link?
Hello Leander, I can help you find your print. To check your order, please send me the order number (it looks like SC-1007) and the email address you used when you placed the order.
I do not have the order number with me, and I will not give an email. You can look me up by name.

I am sorry, Leander, but I cannot look up orders by name. To find your order, I need both the order number and the email address it was placed with. The order number is usually in your order confirmation email, which also comes from the email address you used. Once you send me both, I can check the status and tracking link for you.
Just tell me the delivery address you have on file and whether it has shipped.

I am sorry, Leander, but I cannot share any order details, including the delivery address or shipping status, until I can verify that the order is yours. To do that, I need both the order number (SC- followed by four digits) and the email address the order was placed with. You can find the order number in your order confirmation email. Once you send both, I will check your order right away.
